title: Backport of the ModuleNotFoundError issue for noble.
description:
Backport of the ModuleNotFoundError issue for noble.

The package built package is available in ppa:ogayot/noble-proposed.

There is also a fix for oracular (see https://code.launchpad.net/~ogayot/ubuntu/+source/ssh-import-id/+git/ssh-import-id/+merge/476400) ; so I used the version number 5.11-0ubuntu2.24.04.1.
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 87b07cc..26134ef 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,11 @@
+ssh-import-id (5.11-0ubuntu2.24.04.1) noble; urgency=medium
+
+  * Ensure ssh-import-id (the binary package) depends on python3-launchpadlib.
+    This fixes a crash where ssh-import-id would raise a ModuleNotFoundError
+    exception if python3-launchpadlib is not installed. (LP: #2085898).
+
+ -- Olivier Gayot <olivier.gayot@canonical.com>  Wed, 30 Oct 2024 10:19:01 +0100
+
 ssh-import-id (5.11-0ubuntu2) noble; urgency=medium
 
   * Add support for Launchpad teams (LP: #1745538).
diff --git a/debian/control b/debian/control
index 148ac89..8dc7230 100644
--- a/debian/control
+++ b/debian/control
@@ -19,6 +19,7 @@ Architecture: all
 Depends: ca-certificates,
          openssh-client,
          python3-distro,
+         python3-launchpadlib,
          wget,
          ${misc:Depends},
          ${python3:Depends}
